title: FORMAT with "General Date" in en-US shows the date and the 12-hour time
query: EVALUATE VAR DT = DATE ( 2021, 1, 2 ) + TIME ( 15, 30, 0 ) RETURN ROW ( "r", FORMAT ( DT, "General Date" ) )

source.quote: FORMAT accepts a set of predefined format strings for Date/Time
source.supports: the example table lists each predefined format applied to January 2, 2021 at 15:30:00

source.quote: Displays a date and/or time. For example, 3/12/2008 11:07:31 AM.
